supersedes.scope: answer, evidence.mechanism and evidence.statistics.conclusion; historical bytes retained

replacement.metric: Correct-answer rate conditional on extracting the first standalone A-D token from uppercased generated output; format errors, truncation and wrong options are conflated. It is not pure format compliance.
replacement.lowercase: Accepted because the output is uppercased before regex matching. Verbose output can also score if its first standalone A-D token matches the correct option.
replacement.arm_independence: NOT_ESTABLISHED: the archived source attaches PEFT to base before measuring both arms without an adapter-disable context.
replacement.statistics: Do not infer a scoring artifact from the 0.05/0.05 summary or use an independent-arm chance calculation as causal evidence. The archived arms are not independently isolated.

overturning_evidence: Per-item archived outputs plus an independently isolated, immutable-input-bound run could resolve causes of the low observation; summaries alone cannot.
publication_scope: Source-only supersession. Does not assert deployment to the HF Space or dataset, nor delivery of a correction to any collaborator.
